listings.description: JBFocal Films is a wedding videography business established in 2022 and based in St Austell, Cornwall. In a relatively short trading history, the business has built an established brand within the wedding market, underpinned by a diversified marketing presence that spans the major wedding platforms, print advertising and wedding fairs. This multi-channel visibility keeps the business in front of couples planning their weddings and has supported a growing flow of bookings. The business operates a deliberately flexible, low-overhead model. Work is delivered through a team of freelance associates, each contractually responsible for their own finances, insurance and services, which keeps fixed costs low and allows capacity to flex with demand. Since adopting this subcontracted delivery model, company bookings have increased and overall earnings have risen as package costs to clients have been increased. Offered for sale due to the owner’s health, this is an accessible, low-cost entry into the wedding sector, and would particularly suit a videographer or creative professional looking to step into an established brand with marketing channels already in place. – Established wedding videography brand, trading since 2022 – Turnover approximately £23,000 – Net profit approximately £10,000 – Flexible, low-overhead operating model – Diversified marketing across major wedding platforms, print and wedding fairs – Freelance associate team, each responsible for their own finances, insurance and services – Company bookings increasing, with rising package pricing – Stock available in addition at valuation JBFocal Films provides wedding videography services, with packages priced and sold by the business and delivered by its freelance associates. Client work is won through the business’s established and diversified marketing mix, with a presence on the major wedding platforms complemented by print advertising and attendance at wedding fairs. The subcontractor model means every associate is bound under contract to take full responsibility for their own finances, insurance and services, keeping the operation simple and the overhead base light. The owner reports that bookings have grown under this model, while increased package pricing has lifted overall earnings. The business is based in St Austell, Cornwall. The precise trading address is not disclosed in marketing materials and will be shared with genuinely interested buyers at the appropriate stage of the sale process. No premises or tenure details have been supplied, reflecting the flexible, low-overhead nature of the operation. The asset base is compact, comprising a laptop and hard drives, and buyers should confirm the practical trading arrangements with the brokers as part of their enquiries.

This characterful thoroughfare accommodates a diverse mix of independent retailers, cafés, restaurants and bars. The harbour and Custom House Quay are close by, while Discovery Quay, Events Square and the National Maritime Museum Cornwall are within easy walking distance. The central setting provides opportunities to attract local residents and visitors exploring Falmouth’s shops, waterfront and maritime attractions, making this an appealing location for a hospitality business. Business Description Veritas Business Sales is delighted to offer for sale this stylish cocktail bar and restaurant occupying a desirable trading position in the heart of Falmouth. Our clients extensively refurbished and transformed the premises before opening in April 2024. Their investment included redecoration and the installation of a comprehensive range of quality fixtures, fittings and commercial catering equipment. The business is now offered for sale so that they can focus on their property development interests. The business is operated by the owners, supported by seven part-time members of staff. Our clients report average weekly turnover of approximately £10,000 during the summer months, with drinks accounting for around 70% of sales and the Latin American food offering contributing the remaining 30%.The premises are presented in excellent condition, providing an incoming operator with an attractive and well-equipped bar and restaurant. External seating for approximately 18 customers complements the internal accommodation. There is potential to develop the food offering and explore additional winter opening days. This represents an excellent opportunity to acquire a distinctive hospitality business with an established trading presence, substantial reported summer sales and an extensive fit-out. Early viewing is highly recommended. Term: 7 years Remaining: 4.5 years Rent: £20,000 per annum Business Rates: £800 per annum Further Details On Application.
